parsed.faithful: It would, therefore, be desirable to have an apparatus for the use of the pure oxygenated muriatic acid simply diffused in water, which is at once the cheapest and best vehicle for it. This apparatus must be simple in its construction, and obtainable at a moderate expense; it must confine the liquor in such a manner as to prevent the escape of the oxygenated muriatic acid gas, which is not only a loss of power, but also an inconvenience.
